quests.dispatcherQuestion: Nuclear submarine navigation system failure in disputed international waters. Input code!
quests.hint: Order the submarine to surface for emergency navigation.
quests.explanation: Emergency surfacing allows the vessel to use GPS and visual navigation when classified underwater systems fail.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Coastal nation requesting clarification on submarine presence in their waters. Input code!
quests.hint: Initiate diplomatic contact immediately.
quests.explanation: Diplomatic contact de-escalates a potential military incident by communicating the nature of the emergency transparently.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Towing operation required to bring the disabled submarine to a friendly port. Input code!
quests.hint: Arrange submarine towing to the nearest friendly port.
quests.explanation: Towing disabled submarines requires specialized vessels with underwater attachment systems and security escorts.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Crewed spacecraft experiencing anomalous re-entry trajectory deviation. Input code!
quests.hint: Execute the emergency re-entry abort procedure.
quests.explanation: Re-entry abort procedures redirect the spacecraft to an emergency landing site with appropriate terrain and weather conditions.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Heat shield damage confirmed requiring an adjusted re-entry angle calculation. Input code!
quests.hint: Calculate the adjusted re-entry angle.
quests.explanation: A shallower re-entry angle reduces peak heating on a damaged heat shield at the cost of a longer but survivable deceleration.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Emergency landing site prepared for the damaged spacecraft touchdown. Input code!
quests.hint: Activate the contingency landing site.
quests.explanation: Contingency landing sites are pre-selected for remote area access by recovery teams with medical and technical support.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: BSL-4 laboratory reporting containment failure of a hemorrhagic fever virus. Input code!
quests.hint: Activate BSL-4 hemorrhagic fever containment.
quests.explanation: Hemorrhagic fever containment requires full pressure-suit protocols and extended exposure monitoring for all personnel.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Full facility quarantine required with 30 personnel potentially exposed. Input code!
quests.hint: Quarantine all 30 potentially exposed personnel.
quests.explanation: Personnel quarantine prevents secondary transmission while the virus contagion profile is being confirmed by testing.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Specialized infectious disease unit needed for management of the exposed group. Input code!
quests.hint: Deploy the infectious disease response unit.
quests.explanation: Infectious disease units manage exposed personnel with appropriate containment, monitoring, and clinical support.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Large-scale cyber espionage operation exfiltrating classified government data. Input code!
quests.hint: Block all data exfiltration pathways.
quests.explanation: Data exfiltration blocking seals network egress points to prevent further classified data from leaving government systems.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Systems containing defense plans and intelligence files have been compromised. Input code!
quests.hint: Review and revoke all system access credentials.
quests.explanation: Revoking all credentials forces the attackers out of the network and prevents further access during investigation.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Foreign intelligence agency identified as the source of the cyber operation. Input code!
quests.hint: Brief the national security council on counterintelligence findings.
quests.explanation: National security council briefings authorize the coordinated government response to foreign intelligence operations.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Advanced flood modeling predicting catastrophic inundation within 36 hours. Input code!
quests.hint: Issue a predictive evacuation order.
quests.explanation: Predictive evacuations based on advanced hydrological modeling reduce mortality by acting before flooding is visible.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Temporary flood barriers needed at three critical points in the river system. Input code!
quests.hint: Deploy flood barriers to three critical points.
quests.explanation: Strategic barrier placement at river junctions can redirect water away from population centers during predicted flood events.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Long-range weather station data needed to confirm the flood model accuracy. Input code!
quests.hint: Pull upstream weather and river data.
quests.explanation: Upstream river gauge and rainfall data validates computer models and reduces uncertainty in flood arrival time estimates.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Offshore earthquake triggering both tsunami and coastal landslide warnings simultaneously. Input code!
quests.hint: Issue the compound event emergency code.
quests.explanation: Compound event codes simultaneously trigger tsunami warning systems, landslide teams, and coastal zone evacuation.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Coastal roads at risk of landslide blocking the primary evacuation routes. Input code!
quests.hint: Activate the inland bypass evacuation routes.
quests.explanation: Inland bypass routes avoid landslide-prone coastal cliffs and provide safe passage away from tsunami inundation zones.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Tsunami wave height estimate revised upward requiring an extended evacuation zone. Input code!
quests.hint: Extend the evacuation zone immediately.
quests.explanation: Extending the zone based on updated wave height estimates protects more residents without requiring a full new alert cycle.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Chemical warfare agent deployment confirmed in a populated urban district. Input code!
quests.hint: Activate urban chemical warfare agent response.
quests.explanation: Urban CWA responses deploy specialist CBRN teams with antidotes, mass decontamination, and hospital surge protocols.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Identified agent requires a specific antidote within 30 minutes of exposure. Input code!
quests.hint: Rapidly push antidotes to treatment teams.
quests.explanation: Pre-positioned antidote caches allow mass treatment within the therapeutic window when specific CWA agents are identified.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Agent persisting on surfaces requiring thorough building decontamination operations. Input code!
quests.hint: Deploy surface decontamination teams.
quests.explanation: Surface decontamination removes persistent chemical agents from buildings and streets, making affected areas safe for re-entry.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Ten thousand people requiring decontamination after a mass exposure event. Input code!
quests.hint: Activate mass decontamination operations.
quests.explanation: Mass decontamination operations use mobile shower systems capable of processing hundreds of people per hour.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Decontamination equipment capacity insufficient for the number of exposed people. Input code!
quests.hint: Request a decontamination resource surge.
quests.explanation: Decontamination resource surges draw on military and regional stockpiles to scale up capacity for mass events.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Runoff from the decontamination site creating a secondary environmental hazard. Input code!
quests.hint: Capture all decontamination site runoff.
quests.explanation: Runoff capture systems collect contaminated wash water before it enters drains, preventing secondary water supply contamination.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Nuclear power plant station blackout with all AC power lost to the reactor. Input code!
quests.hint: Initiate station blackout emergency procedures.
quests.explanation: Station blackout procedures activate battery-backed instrumentation and operator-controlled passive cooling systems.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Battery backup providing only 8 hours of cooling before fuel damage will occur. Input code!
quests.hint: Deploy mobile generators to the reactor site.
quests.explanation: Mobile generator deployment extends the cooling window beyond the battery backup limit, preventing fuel damage.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Offsite repair teams working to restore external grid connection to the plant. Input code!
quests.hint: Urgently restore the external grid connection.
quests.explanation: Restoring external grid power is the safest long-term cooling solution and ends dependence on portable backup systems.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Major international earthquake requiring a global disaster coordination center. Input code!
quests.hint: Activate the global coordination center.
quests.explanation: Global coordination centers allocate international aid resources, prevent duplication, and prioritize the most critical needs.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: UN disaster response teams being assembled from 20 contributing nations. Input code!
quests.hint: Mobilize United Nations disaster response teams.
quests.explanation: UN team mobilization provides standardized interoperable response capabilities from multiple nations under one framework.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Medical teams requesting satellite communications for their field hospital operations. Input code!
quests.hint: Assign satellite communications to field medical teams.
quests.explanation: Field hospital satellite links enable real-time medical consultation with specialists at distant advanced facilities.
